command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0067/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: All six 0.38.0 rows, twice each at displacement 200, twelve instructions and 80 bytes: the low rows are six bytes (8b 80 c8 00 00 00 / 89 80 c8 00 00 00), the REX.R and REX.B rows seven (44/45 or 41 ...). This is the mod = 10 shape, so the ModRM byte is 80 + base and the signed disp32 follows at [16,32] or [24,32] behind a REX byte. Only %rsp/%r12 are excluded (SIB); %rbp/%r13 are ordinary bases here (8b 85 c8 00 00 00). input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 80-byte .text.
